41 of 44 PDFs renamed to `YYYY-MM-DD_vendor.pdf`. Three were skipped and keep their original names: `scan_0012.pdf`, `scan_0013.pdf`, and `IMG_2231.pdf`. They are image-only scans with no text layer, so I couldn't read a date or vendor from them.

I can't confirm that the vendor names and dates in the 41 renamed files were extracted correctly, since I haven't spot-checked them. A quick look at a few is worthwhile.

If you give me the dates and vendors for the three scans, I'll rename them. Alternatively, I can run OCR on them if you have an OCR tool available, though that would need your go-ahead.
